stories.title: 会递纸的机器人
paragraphs: Our team has a science project for the school show. We want to make a robot that can hand out paper. Ben is a football player, and he has a clever idea. He puts a small basket in the centre of the robot. I want a blue basket, but he wants a green one.

We discuss the colours and agree to use both. We finish the robot on Friday. It moves slowly, but it can carry ten sheets of paper. Our teacher smiles and says that our teamwork is wonderful. We feel proud of our little helper.
translation: 我们小组为学校展示准备一个科学项目。我们想做一个会发纸的机器人。本是一名足球队员，他有一个聪明的点子：在机器人中央放一个小篮子。我想要蓝篮子，他却想要绿篮子。
我们讨论颜色，决定两种都用。我们星期五完成了机器人。它移动得慢，却能搬十张纸。老师笑着说我们的合作真棒。我们为这个小帮手感到骄傲。

stories.title: 海报上的小意外
paragraphs: I am worried about our class poster. I put the wrong date at the front, and the paint is already dry. I am afraid to tell my partner. At home, I ask a parent for help. Dad does not laugh at my mistake. He asks me to think of a simple way to cover the date.

The next morning, I show my partner a paper flower. We move it over the wrong date and write the new date on it. The change is easy. My partner accepts my apology with a smile. Now our poster has a lovely flower, too.
translation: 我很担心班级海报。我在显眼的位置写错了日期，颜料已经干了。我不敢告诉同伴。回家后我请家长帮忙。爸爸没有嘲笑我的错误，而是让我想一种简单的方法盖住日期。
第二天早上，我给同伴看一朵纸花。我们把它移到错误日期上，再在纸花上写正确日期。修改很容易。同伴微笑着接受了我的道歉。现在海报上还多了一朵漂亮的花。

stories.title: 留一点玩的时间
paragraphs: On Monday, our teacher asks us to make a schedule. I write every subject and every club activity on my page. My plan looks full. I usually start my homework after dinner, but sometimes I am too tired to read. My teacher asks where my play time is.

I look at the page again. On Wednesday, I can play ping-pong before dinner. On Friday, I can draw with my sister. At the weekend, I can visit a grandparent. I do not need a club every afternoon. My new schedule has time for work, play and a good night's sleep.
translation: 星期一，老师让我们做日程表。我把每门学科和每项社团活动都写在纸上。计划看起来满满的。我通常晚饭后开始写作业，可有时累得读不了书。老师问我的玩耍时间在哪里。
我重新看日程表。星期三可以晚饭前打乒乓球。星期五可以和姐姐画画。周末可以探望一位祖辈。我不需要每天下午都参加社团。新日程给学习、玩耍和睡好觉都留了时间。

stories.title: 图书馆的小演出
paragraphs: Our class will perform at the library on Saturday. It is a small concert with music and stories. Mei plays the piano, and Tom brings his guitar. I do not play an instrument, so I choose a short poem by a local poet. We practise together after school.

At the concert, a violin player is nervous. We give her a quiet smile and wait. Then her music fills the room. The visitors are polite and listen carefully. They clap when each part is over. I learn that a good audience can help every performer feel brave. We all enjoy the afternoon.
translation: 星期六我们班要在图书馆表演。这是一场有音乐和故事的小音乐会。梅弹钢琴，汤姆带吉他。我不会演奏乐器，就选了一位当地诗人的短诗。我们放学后一起练习。
演出时，一位小提琴手很紧张。我们安静地微笑，等她准备好。随后琴声充满房间。来访者很有礼貌，认真聆听，每一部分结束后才鼓掌。我明白了，好的观众能帮助表演者更勇敢。大家都度过了愉快的下午。

stories.title: 关掉手机的晚上
paragraphs: It is eight in the evening. Dad wants to watch one more show on his phone. I want to play one more game. Mum asks if we have enough free time to rest before bed. We both look at the clock. We should change this evening habit.

Dad puts his phone away, and I close my game. We read a funny story together. Soon my little brother is asleep on the sofa. I am still awake, but I feel calm. The next morning, we have more energy. We decide that a quiet story is a good way to end our day.
translation: 晚上八点，爸爸还想用手机再看一个节目，我还想再玩一局游戏。妈妈问，睡觉前我们有没有足够的空闲时间休息。我们都看了看钟。这个晚间习惯应该改一改。
爸爸收起手机，我关掉游戏。我们一起读一个有趣的故事。弟弟很快就在沙发上睡着了。我还醒着，但感到很平静。第二天早上，我们更有精神。我们决定用安静地读故事来结束一天。

stories.title: 健康角的提醒
paragraphs: Our class makes a healthy habits corner. I draw a big tooth and write that I brush my teeth twice a day. Mei adds a picture about exercise. Tom writes a reminder to take care of our eyes. We check every sentence with our teacher.

During a break, we practise taking a slow breath. We breathe in and out quietly, then stretch our arms. We also plan to spend less time sitting in one place. At home, I read for half an hour, then help set the table. Our corner is not just a poster. It reminds us to try small habits every day.
translation: 我们班做了一个健康习惯角。我画一颗大牙齿，写上我每天刷牙两次。梅添了一张关于运动的图。汤姆写下爱护眼睛的提醒。我们和老师一起检查每句话。
课间，我们练习慢慢呼吸，安静地吸气、呼气，再伸展双臂。我们也打算少些长时间坐着。回家后我读半小时书，再帮忙摆餐桌。健康角不只是一张海报，它提醒我们每天尝试小小的好习惯。

stories.title: 种子到汤碗
paragraphs: Grandma shows me a carrot seed. It is much smaller than I expect. In our science book, we can see the stem above the soil and the root below it. A few months later, we visit a farm and help pull some carrots from the ground. What an interesting world plants have!

At home, Grandma finds a simple soup recipe. A carrot is our first ingredient. We add a little water and some other vegetables. The soup has a sweet flavour. We eat it with porridge. I tell my brother that our meal begins with tiny seeds and a lot of patient care.
translation: 奶奶给我看一粒胡萝卜种子，比我想的还小。科学书里能看到土上面的茎和土下面的根。几个月后，我们去农场，帮忙从地里拔胡萝卜。植物的世界真有趣！
回家后，奶奶找了一个简单的汤食谱。胡萝卜是第一样食材。我们加一点水和其他蔬菜。汤有甜甜的味道，我们配着粥吃。我告诉弟弟，这顿饭从小种子和许多耐心的照料开始。

paragraphs: Our class is hungry after the farm visit. The small cafe has beef noodles, vegetable dumplings and sandwiches. There is also a hamburger on the menu. We look at the choices before ordering. Our teacher asks us to think about what each person wants.

Mei chooses a sandwich. Ben wants dumplings, and I choose noodles. Dad, who joins our trip, has tea. My brother wants coconut water and an ice cream, but first he chooses his lunch. We sit around a round table and talk about the morning. Different choices can make one happy meal. We do not all need the same food.

stories.title: 改变徒步计划
paragraphs: We plan to go hiking near the river on Saturday. Our guide wants to show us a waterfall and a forest path below the mountain. Before we leave, Dad checks the weather. There may be heavy rain, strong wind and fog in the afternoon. We put a raincoat in each bag, but the guide suggests a different plan.

We visit the nature centre instead. From its windows, we can see the river safely. We draw the forest and learn about animals that need shelter. The hike can wait for a fine day. A changed plan can still give us a wonderful trip.

我们改去自然中心，可以从窗内安全地看河流。我们画森林，了解需要庇护处的动物。徒步可以等到晴天再去。改变计划，仍然能有一次精彩的出游。

stories.title: 窗边的风景画
paragraphs: Our hotel has a window beside a small table. From it, we can see a lake and a round island. I bring my sketchbook because I want to draw the view. Before sunrise, the sky is pale pink. Dad and I sit quietly and watch the colours change.

In the afternoon, dark clouds arrive, so we close the window. I know we cannot see the sunset today. Instead, I use my morning drawing to make a postcard for Grandma. I add the lake, the island and the pink sky. One small window gives me a whole page of happy memories.
translation: 酒店有一扇靠着小桌子的窗户。从窗里能看到湖和圆圆的小岛。我带了速写本，想画这里的风景。日出前天空是淡粉色，我和爸爸安静地坐着，看颜色变化。
下午来了乌云，我们关上窗。我知道今天看不到日落了，就用早上的画给奶奶做明信片，画上湖、小岛和粉红色天空。一扇小窗，给了我满满一页快乐回忆。

stories.title: 聚会中的两份工作
paragraphs: Our class has a party before the holiday. I want to perform a song, but I also promise to help with the story show. Both jobs need time. At first, I try to do everything alone. I look worried, and I nearly forget to finish the poster for our project.

My team notices my problem. One friend can paint, and another can play music. We share the work and put our phones away. Soon I have free time to practise my song. At the party, our story show goes well. We smile at each other. Sharing work helps everyone enjoy the day.
translation: 假期前我们班举办聚会。我想唱歌，也答应帮忙准备故事表演，两份工作都要花时间。起初我想一个人包办一切，结果很担心，还差点忘了完成项目海报。
同伴发现了我的问题。一个朋友会画画，另一个会演奏音乐。我们分工，收起手机。很快我就有空练歌了。聚会时故事表演很顺利，我们相视微笑。分担工作，让每个人都能享受这一天。

stories.title: 给未来的自己
paragraphs: Dear next-term me, you are still young, and there is much to learn. You do not need to be the clever one in every game. Everyone has different skills. The best way to learn is to ask, listen and try. Remember the robot project and the flower on the poster.

Keep one good habit from this term. You usually read before bed now, so keep doing that. At the weekend, leave time for family and play. Choose one small goal, not ten big ones. Make a kind decision when a friend needs help. I hope you will enjoy learning. Yours, this-term me.
translation: 亲爱的下学期的我：你还小，还有很多东西要学。你不需要在每场游戏里都最聪明。每个人有不同的本领。学习的好方法是提问、聆听和尝试。记住机器人项目和海报上的纸花。
保留这个学期的一个好习惯。你现在通常睡前阅读，就继续吧。周末给家人和玩耍留时间。选一个小目标，而不是十个大目标。朋友需要帮助时，作一个友善的决定。希望你享受学习。此致，本学期的我。
